excerpt: Using a time projection chamber with 3.7-tonne of liquid xenon target and an exposure of 0.63 tonne-year, 1058 candidate events are identified ... a lowest excluded cross section (90% C.L.) of 3.8 × 10⁻⁴⁷ cm² at a dark matter mass of 40 GeV/c².
title: Dark Matter Search Results from the PandaX-4T Commissioning Run
